title: Facebook & Instagram Ads for Pet Businesses | PetPath

facts.fact: PetPath's free Meta ads plan is offered with no obligation and no sales pitch, with results promised within 48 hours (vendor claim).
facts.quote: Free · No obligation · No sales pitch · Results within 48 hours

facts.fact: PetPath says customers can pause a Meta ads plan with 15 days' notice.
PetPath says its Meta ads plans have no lock-in contract, and customers can pause or change their plan with 15 days' notice.
facts.quote: No lock-in contract. Pause or change your plan with 15 days’ notice.

facts.fact: PetPath says the ad budget is paid directly to Meta, and its management fee is separate and fixed monthly, quoted after the free plan.
facts.quote: Your ad spend goes directly to Meta. Our management fee is separate and fixed monthly, quoted after the free plan.

facts.fact: PetPath's Meta ads pricing page lists ad budget, number of campaigns and offers, and content creation as cost components, but does not publish a specific fee amount.
PetPath's free Meta ads self-check contains eight items that a business ticks to score its ads.
facts.quote: Tick everything that’s true for your business today.

facts.fact: PetPath's Meta ads self-check is described as taking 60 seconds to complete.
facts.quote: Take the 60-second self-check to see where you stand.

facts.fact: Meta restricts ads for prescription medicines and has rules on promoting the sale of animals, according to PetPath's description of Meta's policies.
facts.quote: Meta restricts ads for prescription medicines and has rules on promoting the sale of animals.

facts.fact: PetPath says testimonials and before-and-after photos in Meta ads must be real and used with the owner's permission.
facts.quote: Testimonials and before-and-afters must be real and used with the owner’s permission.

facts.fact: PetPath says it reports cost per enquiry to clients monthly.
facts.quote: Monthly report on cost per enquiry

facts.fact: PetPath Digital is described as a digital marketing studio based in Punjab, India, that works only with pet businesses.
facts.quote: PetPath Digital is a digital marketing studio based in Punjab, India, that works only with pet businesses

facts.fact: PetPath says it keeps the client's ad account and Meta pixel in the client's name.
facts.quote: Keep your ad account and pixel in your name

facts.fact: PetPath lists vet clinics as a business type for Meta ads, with the restriction that no prescription products may be promoted.
